business-domain-context

Business domain map

What the product is for, how it earns, and what every domain term means. Product language is Spanish (Uruguay); UI labels and domain terms are kept verbatim.

Overview

Confidence: High for what the code does, Medium for the market framing (it comes from the PRD, not from code). Note: the target's root README.md describes the development boilerplate, not the product; product facts come from .context/, the landing page and the code.

Problem. Uruguayan accountants prepare tax returns for DGI (the tax authority) by hand: they take the monthly TXT exported from their accounting software (Memory) and turn it into the file that PADI, DGI's filing program, imports (.context/PRD/product-overview.md). The work is repetitive, error-prone and scales badly with the number of clients.

What the product delivers today. tuDeclaracion.com ("Declaraciones DGI sin fricción" on the landing, src/app/page.tsx) takes the monthly accounting TXT, validates it line by line, resolves each line against a per-company chart of accounts and produces PADI-compatible files for two declarations: the DJ 2181 (purchases and sales detail by RUT, with IVA) and the DJ 1376 (monthly IVA plus income-tax advance payments; totals per line code, with the 2181 as its annex). Both are produced from the same import (src/app/dashboard/dashboard-client.tsx, src/modules/exporter/).

Target users. The accountant (contador or estudio contable) who files for many companies from one login; each company's data is isolated by Row Level Security on empresa.cuenta_id (supabase/migrations/20260712000000_baseline_cuenta_empresa.sql). The landing plans are named "Contador independiente", "Estudio contable chico" and "Estudio contable mediano" (src/modules/planes/planes.ts). The PRD also names a secondary persona (a person filing without an accountant); the code has no separate role for it (documented intent only, lower confidence).

Value proposition. From TXT to a PADI-ready file in minutes, with errors explained in place (in-app Ayuda module, "Ver ayuda" links) and the company's accounting rules stored as configuration instead of hard-coded. The footer states the product is a support tool: "Herramienta de apoyo. No reemplaza asesoramiento contable ni legal."

Not available yet. Declarations 2183 and 1050 appear on the dashboard as disabled options and the plans promise "las cuatro declaraciones" (TIPOS_DECLARACION in dashboard-client.tsx).

QA relevance

Business aspectTesting implication
Output is a regulatory file DGI importsA wrong amount or code is a filing error: assert file content (fields, 12-digit zero padding, integer rounding), not only that a download happens.
One accountant, many companiesCross-account isolation is the core security test (RLS on every table scoped through the company).
Rules confirmed by the accountant, changing over timeTest data must come from accountant-confirmed examples (.context/Tax-rules/); expect rules to move.
Subscription model is a placeholderPlans and trial are marketing content only today; do not write billing tests.
Dollar lines use the BCU rate of the previous business dayDate and weekend/holiday edge cases decide the amount; the external service can fail (cache fallback).

RUT

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTable / collectionFound in
RUT declaranteempresa.rut"RUT"db:empresasupabase/migrations/20260719073000_validar_formato_rut_empresa.sql
RUT de la línea (cliente/proveedor)asiento.rut"RUT" (column of the TXT)db:asientosrc/modules/parser/parse-asientos.ts

Business meaning. Uruguayan taxpayer number, 12 digits. It plays two roles: the declaring company, and the third party (customer or supplier) of each accounting line. The 2181 declares detail per third-party RUT; the 1376 ignores it, so a line outside the 2181 may carry any value (ADR-0008).

Related terms. Empresa, Asiento, Declaración 2181.

Structure. See discovery-gaps (data map placeholder).

Período

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTable / collectionFound in
Período (month filed)periodo (text AAAAMM)"Período de la declaración"db:declaracion, db:declaracion_1376supabase/migrations/20260717170000_crear_declaracion.sql

Business meaning. The month a declaration covers, written AAAAMM (for example 202506). The dashboard groups the 2181 and the 1376 of a month in one row; a period is "Completo" when both are generated. A company has at most one declaration per period and form; deleting a period removes both declarations and their lines.

UI labels. "Período de la declaración", "Actividad reciente", "Completo".

Related terms. Declaración 2181, Declaración 1376, Asiento.

Asiento

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTable / collectionFound in
Asiento (accounting line)asiento, AsientoLine"Importar asiento"; TXT columns "Día", "Debe", "Haber", "Concepto", "RUT", "Moneda", "Total", "Código IVA", "IVA", "Cotización", "Libro"db:asientosrc/modules/parser/parse-asientos.ts

Business meaning. One line of the monthly accounting TXT exported from the accountant's software (Memory). In the file, "Debe" and "Haber" are account codes, not amounts; the amounts are "Total" and "IVA". A line is either "formato rápido" (Código IVA above 0, the IVA code identifies the concept) or "asiento abierto" (Código IVA equal to 0, the account in Debe or Haber identifies it). The file is rejected whole when any mandatory field is invalid; an unrecognised "Tipo" is ignored instead of rejected.

UI labels. "Importar asiento", "Sí, reemplazar" (when the period already has lines), "Ver ayuda".

Related terms. Libro, Tipo, Código IVA, RUT, Cotización BCU, Período.

Abbreviations. TXT (the import file), DJ (declaración jurada).

Structure. See discovery-gaps (data map placeholder).

Libro

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTable / collectionFound in
Libroasiento.libro, LIBRO_VALUES"Libro"db:asientosrc/modules/parser/parse-asientos.ts

Business meaning. Category of the line in the TXT: purchases-side or sales-side book. Per the SRS (documented, confirmed by the accountant), C and E are purchases, V and I are sales, P is free use. It is cross-checked against the account prefix (accounts starting with 1 are purchases, with 2 are sales); an inconsistent line is excluded from the 2181. Lowercase values are accepted and uppercased.

Related terms. Asiento, Código IVA. Values: see Enumerations.

Structure. See discovery-gaps.

Tipo

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTable / collectionFound in
Tipoasiento.tipo, TIPO_504, esTipoIgnorado"Tipo"db:asientosrc/modules/parser/parse-asientos.ts

Business meaning. Optional marker on a TXT line. 504 forces the line into the 2181 (compra exenta). Any value containing letters (examples in code comments: CIE, RES, DIF, APE) is ignored by every declaration. Any other numeric value is treated as a data-entry mistake and handled as if Tipo were empty (rule dated 2026-11-10; using Tipo for a direct PADI code is deferred to "versión 2.0").

Related terms. Asiento, Código PADI.

Structure. See discovery-gaps.

Plan de cuentas

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTable / collectionFound in
Plan de cuentas (per company)plan_cuentas, PlanCuentaRow"Cuenta contable", "Código IVA", "Código PADI"db:plan_cuentassupabase/migrations/20260715120000_rediseno_plan_cuentas.sql

Business meaning. The company's own mapping from accounting accounts to PADI codes, entered when the empresa is created and editable later. It is free data, not a fixed catalog: several accounts can resolve to the same PADI code, and each row belongs to one declaration (2181 or 1376). Exempt-purchase accounts carry no IVA code and match by account only.

UI labels. "Cuenta contable", "Código IVA", "Código PADI", "Quitar código de IVA", "Quitar cuenta exenta".

Related terms. Empresa, Código IVA, Código PADI, Mapeo 1376.

Structure. The two resolution paths and uniqueness rules belong to the data map: see discovery-gaps.

Código IVA

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTable / collectionFound in
Código IVAasiento.codigo_iva, plan_cuentas.codigo_iva, mapeo_1376.codigo_iva"Código IVA"db:asiento, db:plan_cuentas, db:mapeo_1376supabase/migrations/20260715120000_rediseno_plan_cuentas.sql

Business meaning. A single digit 0 to 9 that the accountant's software writes on each TXT line. 0 means an open entry (the account decides); 1 to 9 are company-defined codes of the "formato rápido" (what each digit means is set by the company in its plan de cuentas, not by the product).

Related terms. Plan de cuentas, Asiento, Mapeo 1376.

Structure. See discovery-gaps.

Código PADI

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTable / collectionFound in
Código PADI (line code of the 2181)codigo_padi, CODIGOS_PADI_IVA, CODIGO_PADI_EXENTA"505 — IVA compras tasa básica", "506 — IVA compras tasa mínima", "502 — IVA ventas tasa básica", "503 — IVA ventas tasa mínima", exempt purchases 504db:plan_cuentassrc/modules/empresa/plan-cuentas.ts

Business meaning. The concept (casilla) a 2181 line is reported under in PADI. Each output line carries the declarant RUT, form number 02181, period, third-party RUT, period again, the code and a 12-digit zero-padded integer amount. Net amounts of zero or less are not written.

Related terms. Declaración 2181, Plan de cuentas, Código de línea 1376.

Abbreviations. PADI (DGI's filing program), DGI.

Structure. See discovery-gaps.

Declaración 2181

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTable / collectionFound in
DJ 2181declaracion, NUMERO_DECLARACION_2181"2181", "Pendiente de generar", "Generada"db:declaracionsupabase/migrations/20260717170000_crear_declaracion.sql

Business meaning. The DGI declaration listing IVA purchases and sales detail per third-party RUT and PADI code. Lines that cannot be resolved (no mapping, inconsistent Libro, invalid amount or RUT, out-of-scope Tipo) are excluded and listed to the user. It is also the mandatory annex of the 1376.

Related terms. Declaración 1376, Código PADI, Período, Asiento.

Abbreviations. DJ 2181.

Structure. State machine: see discovery-gaps (data map placeholder). Values in Enumerations.

Declaración 1376

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTable / collectionFound in
DJ 1376declaracion_1376"1376", "Pendiente de generar", "Generada"db:declaracion_1376supabase/migrations/20260923100806_crear_declaracion_1376.sql

Business meaning. Monthly declaration of IVA and income-tax advance payments for CEDE and Grandes Contribuyentes (per the SRS, documented intent). In the product it has no upload of its own: it is computed over the same lines as the 2181, giving one total per line code, with credit notes counted as negative. The export is CODIGO;MONTO text, no header, integer amounts.

Related terms. Declaración 2181, Mapeo 1376, Código de línea 1376.

Abbreviations. CEDE, DJ 1376.

Structure. See discovery-gaps.

Mapeo 1376

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTable / collectionFound in
Mapeo del 1376mapeo_1376, guardar_mapeo_1376"Configurar el mapeo del 1376", "Código IVA", "Cuenta contable", "Lado"db:mapeo_1376supabase/migrations/20260901121000_crear_mapeo_1376.sql

Business meaning. The one-time setup per company that ties each 1376 line code to an accounting account, the side (Debe or Haber) to read, and optionally an IVA code. One code maps to at most one account and one account to at most one code. Lines on accounts not mapped trigger a warning before download.

Related terms. Código de línea 1376, Plan de cuentas, Declaración 1376.

Cotización BCU

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTable / collectionFound in
Cotización (exchange rate)cotizacion_bcu_cache, asiento.cotizacion, CODIGO_DOLAR_INTERBANCARIO_FONDO"Cotización", "Reintentar"db:cotizacion_bcu_cachesrc/modules/cotizacion/fetch-cotizacion-bcu.ts

Business meaning. The dollar-to-peso rate used for TXT lines in dollars ("Moneda" = 1). DGI requires the rate of the business day before the entry, and the product gets it from the Banco Central del Uruguay web service, caching one value per currency and date. A rate written in the TXT takes precedence. If the rate for the needed day is unavailable the import is rejected with its own error. Converted amounts are rounded to integers.

Related terms. Asiento. Abbreviations: BCU.

Structure. See discovery-gaps.

Discovery gaps

  • Data map missing. business-data-context is still a placeholder: attributes, relationships, state machines (declaration estado, company estado), RLS and the RPCs (insertar_asientos, crear_empresa_con_plan_cuentas, editar_empresa_con_plan_cuentas, guardar_mapeo_1376) are not documented here. Every term- section points to this gap. Next step: project-context mode data.
  • Cost Structure (canvas) is Unknown, requires user input.
  • Revenue model: plans, prices and trial are placeholders; no billing integration, no subscription table, the chosen plan on /signup?plan= is not persisted. Confirm the real commercial model.
  • Secondary customer segment (user without accountant) is in the PRD only; no code path or role.
  • Declarations 2183 and 1050 are promised in the plans ("las cuatro declaraciones") but disabled in the UI; rule documents exist under .context/Tax-rules/2183 and 1050, no engine.
  • PADI codes 552 and 553 (venta por cuenta ajena) are in the SRS catalog but absent from CODIGOS_PADI_IVA; confirm whether the product must support them.
  • 1376 line catalog is a provisional seed (migration comment): official DGI catalog not captured.
  • declaracion.estado = con_errores is allowed by the DB; the dashboard labels only abierta and generada, and no writer was found.
  • Meaning of Código IVA digits 1 to 9 is per company (set in the plan de cuentas); there is no product-wide table of their meaning.
  • Libro meaning (C, E, V, I, P) comes from the SRS (accountant-confirmed, documented), not verified against a code comment of the enum itself.
  • Terms not given their own section because they have no table or code entity: CEDE and Grandes Contribuyentes (taxpayer classes), IRAE, IPAT, ICOSA (taxes named in 1376 line concepts), "Camino 1" and "Camino 2" (internal names of the two resolution criteria). Add them when the data map exists.
  • Legacy inputs: the target's .context/business/business-model.md was read as input; the target has no domain-glossary.md to migrate.
